eqpt:IngrTotal5min.label: current Ingress stats in 5 minute
comment: A class that represents the most current statistics for  Ingress in a 5 minute sampling interval.  This class updates every 10 seconds.
Total  Ingress  Bytes.  This is the average value read by the counter during the collection interval.  Note that this value resets to 0 at the beginning of each interval.
bytesAvg.label: Total Ingress Bytes average value

comment: Total  Ingress  Bytes.  This is the cumulative value of the counter after the last reset of the hardware counter.  Note that this value continues through each interval without resetting to zero.  Used for internal purposes.
bytesBase.label: Total Ingress Bytes baseline

comment: Total  Ingress  Bytes.  The total sum of the values read.  Note that this value continues through each interval without resetting to zero.
bytesCum.label: Total Ingress Bytes cumulative

comment: Total  Ingress  Bytes.  This is the most current value read by the counter.
bytesLast.label: Total Ingress Bytes current value

comment: Total  Ingress  Bytes.  This is the largest value read by the counter during the collection interval.  This value is only overwritten if the most current value is larger than the previous value.  For example, if the value of the first reading is 3 and the value of the second reading is 4, the previous value is overwritten with 4.  If the third reading is smaller than 4, the value remains at 4.  Note that this value resets to 0 at the beginning of each interval.
bytesMax.label: Total Ingress Bytes maximum value

comment: Total  Ingress  Bytes.  This is the smallest value read by the counter during the collection interval.  This value is only overwritten if the most current value is smaller than the previous value.  For example, if the value of the first reading is 3 and the value of the second reading is 2, the previous value is overwritten with 2.  If the third reading is larger than 2, the value remains at 2.  Note that this value resets to 0 at the beginning of each interval.
bytesMin.label: Total Ingress Bytes minimum value

comment: Total  Ingress  Bytes.  The total sum of the values read during the collection interval.  Note that this value resets to 0 at the beginning of each interval.
bytesPer.label: Total Ingress Bytes periodic

comment: Total  Ingress  Bytes.  This is the rate of the counter during the collection interval.  The rate is calculated by dividing the periodic value by the length of the collection interval.  Note that this value resets to 0 at the beginning of each interval.
bytesRate.label: Total Ingress Bytes rate
